entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
This is unbelievable. I've been on hold for ten minutes! I want to return these horrible shoes NOW.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. I'm sorry to keep you waiting. How can I help you today?
I already said! I need to return these useless cycling shoes. They're a torture device, not a performance product.
I understand you're upset, and I can certainly look into that return for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-0921. I'm telling you, this is the last time I buy from you if this isn't handled. These things have given me terrible blisters.

I'm very sorry to hear about the discomfort. Let me pull up that order... Okay, I see the Pro-Ride cycling shoes, delivered about 84 days ago. Just to be sure, is the issue a technical fault with the shoe, or is it a preference issue regarding the fit?

It's a design flaw! I've adjusted the cleats ten times, I've tried every kind of sock. Nothing works. They just tear up my heels. I want a full refund, and I don't want to hear about any 'policy'. This is your fault.
I appreciate you explaining that. I can see how frustrating that would be after trying to make them work. Let me just review the return eligibility for you.
Review? Don't you dare tell me I'm out of luck. I'll post a review with pictures of the blisters on every website you can think of. Get me your manager right now. I'm done talking to you.

There's no need for that, sir. I can absolutely resolve this for you. I've just checked our policy, and for our standard items like these cycling shoes, we have a 90-day return window. Since you're at 84 days, you are well within the timeframe to make a return for a full refund.
Wait, seriously? So you're just going to take them back? No hassle?

That's correct. I am processing the return authorization now. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account. Just pack the shoes in a box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, we'll issue the refund to your original payment method.
Oh. Okay then. That's... that's what I expected. Fine. Send the label.
It has just been sent. You should see it in your inbox shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
